text:
anya: Quick note — I ran into inconsistent param names while updating the migration guide: some SDK examples use `model_variant`, others use `model`. Can we pick one and update glossary + examples?
rachel: Strong vote for `model` (keeps parity with REST and is simpler for users). We should document _how_ to include variant information in the value.
tom: Agreed. Proposal: standardize on `model` param and show variant in the identifier, e.g. `redwood/guanaco-7b-q4`. I'll update a couple of Python/TS snippets.
anya: Great — can someone write a 2-sentence glossary blurb and a one-line migration hint for the guide? Something very short: what "family", "variant", and "profile" mean.
rachel: Draft: "model family: base model name (e.g., guanaco-7b). variant: packaging/quant suffixes (e.g., -q4, -int8). profile: serving profile that maps to runtime choices (e.g., low-latency, cost-optimized). Example usage: `model='redwood/guanaco-7b-q4'` (include variant in value)."
anya: Perfect. Can you land that in a glossary PR and tag me?
tom: Will do. Also found one broken link in the migration guide when running local linkcheck — `https://old.example.com/migrate` -> 404. Replace with `/docs/guides/migration#migrating-params`.
docs-ci: Link check for branch docs/param-harmonize-1797 queued. Will run after PRs merge.
rachel: Tone note: migration guide currently says "you must" for this tidy-up. Recommend we phrase as "we recommend" since this is not a breaking API removal. Keep prescriptive language only for actual breaking changes.
tom: Agreed. I'll soften wording as I update examples.
anya: Action items: 1) rachel: open glossary PR with blurb + example (ETA today) 2) tom: update SDK snippets & migration guide link + tone (ETA tomorrow) 3) docs-ci: run link/lint after merges.
rachel: PR opened: docs/glossary/1797 — pinged @anya for review.
tom: I'll open sdk/snippets/1797 and reference the glossary PR.
docs-ci: Linkcheck will run automatically on merge.
anya: Thanks everyone — small, fast sync. Closing thread once both PRs merged. :white_check_mark:
